title: Smoky Egyptian Kebabs with Spicy Falafel Sauce
description: Indulge in the bold flavors of Egypt with these smoky kebabs served with a spicy falafel sauce.

ingredients.name: Egyptian Spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together kebabs, Egyptian spices, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil.
Thread kebabs onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, combine falafel, olives, onions, and tomatoes in a bowl.
Once kebabs are cooked, brush with olive oil and season with salt.
Serve kebabs with spicy falafel sauce (see note).
Note: To make spicy falafel sauce, blend falafel, garlic, and lemon juice in a blender until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
